note: Patcher matrix for B181, built from main at 9f3bee0. Seeded per variant from the B180 matrix outputs. Seeding matters here beyond convenience: VF2 builds INHERIT assets from the seed, so a seed older than the previous release carries that release's art forward and silently skips what the newer releases changed -- the same class of defect as a bundle shipping fewer asset patches than the build produced. B180 is the release that carried the corrected furniture art, so B181 seeds from it rather than from anything earlier. Each of the 32 seeds was checked individually for the three things the runtime payload contract needs -- wc.dat, the Original Virtual Families 2 Assets folder, and a linked exe -- rather than by taking the newest directory, because an interrupted run leaves a directory that satisfies none of them and the directory is created before anything links. 32/32 verified complete, and the variant names were cross-checked against build-matrix-toggles.json with zero missing. Adds since B180: villager actions of their OWN for the Exercise Bike, Home Gym System, Yoga Equipment and Ping-Pong Table -- each a new behaviour id bound to its own handler, reusing the donor's animations and duration but not its identity. The Home Gym had no action at all before. The picnic/patio prop draw installer, which was defined in main and never called, is now invoked. The spa-lounger rest loop fix, which had been stranded on an unmerged branch. The furniture probe now matches on the unique placement handle instead of hit-testing a walk-to anchor. The placed-furniture sanity bound corrected from 0x400 to the engine's real 0x200. The Invisible Spa Lounger ships its own sprite in the build, not just in the source. The widowed-remarriage change is NOT included: the owner ruled that behaviour intentional base-game design.
